Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> I presume that if Watenda cancels a superior Lightning Reflexes then
> the Lightningy person does not burn the X blood.

Correct. Burning X is part of the effect that was canceled.

> Can the Lightningy person play another card to gain additonal strikes?

Yes.

> the rulebook says 'may not _use_ more than one effect', and since the
> Lightning got cancelled, it wasn't used...so....

This would be true of even, say, canceling Blur.
